ja: • 『機動戦士ガンダム００８３』より、パワードジム、ジム改に続く３体目の0083系ジムがHGUCシリーズで登場。
• 関節の可動範囲を広く確保。
• 外装パーツは完全新規。独特な細身のラインを再現。
成形品×7、マーキングシール×1、組立説明書
en: • From "Mobile Suit Gundam 0083", the third 0083-based gym following Powered Jim and Jim Kai appears in the HGUC series.
• Ensures a wide range of motion in the joints.
• Exterior parts are completely new. Reproduces a unique slender line.
• 6 types of wrist parts are included.
Molded product x 7, MarkingSeal x 1, assembly manual
